blurb: Tennessee River Gorge Island Cabins® offers 3 private waterfront cabins on 5 acres of TRG® Island with a shared 16' x 36' swimming pool. Cabins come fully furnished with covered decks, boat docks, 1 canoe or 2 kayaks, gas grills, and a crate of seasoned firewood each night. The property includes new Amish-built mountain treehouse cabins on nearby mountain land and access to hiking trails.
